Predicates:
Register(x) ::: x can register to vote in the United States.
Participate(x) ::: x can participate in the 2024 United States presidential election.
CitizenUS(x) ::: x has United States citizenship.
CitizenTW(x) ::: x has Taiwanese citizenship.
CitizenRF(x) ::: x has Russian Federation citizenship.
OfficialRF(x) ::: x is a Russian Federation official.
Manager(x) ::: x is a manager at Gazprom.
Premises:
∀x (Register(x) → Participate(x)) ::: Everyone who can register to vote in the United States can participate in the 2024 United States presidential election.
∀x (CitizenUS(x) → Register(x)) ::: If someone has United States citizenship, then they can register to vote in the United States.
∀x (CitizenUS(x) ⊕ CitizenTW(x)) ::: A person either has United States citizenship or Taiwanese citizenship.
∀x (OfficialRF(x) → ¬CitizenTW(x)) ::: No Russian Federation officials hold Taiwanese citizenship.
¬(CitizenTW(vladimir) ∨ Manager(vladimir)) ::: Vladimir neither holds Taiwanese citizenship nor is he a manager at Gazprom.
Register(ekaterina) ∨ OfficialRF(ekaterina) ::: Ekaterina can register to vote in the United States, or she is a Russian Federation official.
Conclusion:
¬OfficialRF(vladimir) ::: Vladimir is not a Russian Federation official.
